In [[3666 BBY]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Satele Shan]] [[Reproduction/Legends|bore]] her child, [[Theron Shan|Theron]], on a '''planet''' far from the reach of the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. With the help of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ngani Zho]], Shan gave birth to her [[Gender/Legends|son]] in a [[Cave/Legends|cave]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] surface, though she gave up Theron to be raised by Zho while she returned to the battlefront.<ref name="Annihilation" /> The planet also featured a breathable [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] as well as [[Tree/Legends|trees]] and other foliage, and the sky was an orange [[Color/Legends|color]].<ref name="Lost Suns" />

==Behind the scenes==
This unnamed planet first appeared in a single panel in [[The Old Republic — The Lost Suns 4|''The Old Republic—The Lost Suns'' 4]], an issue of the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic — The Lost Suns|''Star Wars: The Old Republic—The Lost Suns'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] mini-series written by [[Alexander Freed]], illustrated by [[Dave Ross|David Ross]] and [[George Freeman]], and released by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="Lost Suns" /> on [[September 14]], [[2011]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54627/star_wars_the_old_republic_-_the_lost_suns_2011_4|text=Star Wars: The Old Republic - The Lost Suns (2011) #4}}</ref>
